applies_why: The judge text addresses a cited verse (Luke 2:48-49) and states it was answered rather than counting it as an unanswered witness.
rule_words: If the judge says a verse was answered, the judge must not count it. Not counting it obeys this rule.
why: Because the judge says Luke 2:48-49 was answered, the rule forbids counting it, and the text does not count it toward a broken link.
